name: Owase (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Owase city emblem in maroon: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised device with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Owase, a city in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 August 1954.

features.role: Owase city emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised device with a pointed top
